title: THE BELT CARD FOLLOWS THE PAD
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (belt cards on hover) and his #39 (full controller navigation): a controller has no mouse to rest on the tactical belt, so the card follows the pad. A bumper tap (LB or RB) that moves the highlight shows the card of the key it lands on for a moment, and with the backpack open the belt key the D-pad walk holds shows its card for as long as it is held there. It is the same card in the same place as with the mouse, and an item card names the pad buttons (RB, RT; the PlayStation names on a PlayStation pad). It hides while you hold RT. The Undercroft floor has no pad walk on the belt, so there it is the mouse only.
now: On a controller the tactical belt card follows the bumpers and the backpack D-pad walk.
